confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge. No live menus, booking pages or listings were checked, and July 2026 prices are projected rather than observed. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable. Hotel and hostel rates vary widely by district and may shift with regional security conditions. The cocktail (about 1.5 times the beer anchor) and wine glass (about 1.4 times the beer anchor) were set relative to beer because direct local knowledge of alcohol prices is weak; alcohol is heavily taxed and sold only in licensed venues. The fx observation comes from RBA search-result summaries, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is Amman's own price level as a mid-priced Levantine capital, placed loosely between lower-cost Cairo and higher-cost Tel Aviv for restaurants and hotels.

anchor_basis.beer: standard serving of domestic lager at a licensed restaurant, about 4.0 JOD
anchor_basis.coffee: regular cappuccino at an independent cafe in Amman, about 2.2 JOD
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: shawarma or grilled-chicken plate with a soft drink at a casual local eatery, about 3.5 JOD
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: starter, main and dessert each for two at a mid-range restaurant, no drinks, about 35 JOD total
anchor_basis.cocktail: standard gin or vodka cocktail at a city bar, about 6.0 JOD
anchor_basis.wine_glass: glass of house red or white at a restaurant, about 5.5 JOD
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: dorm bed in a registered hostel in central Amman, about 8.5 JOD per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room in a registered hostel, about 24 JOD per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic double room at a registered guesthouse, about 28 JOD per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: double room at a registered three-star hotel in Abdoun or Shmeisani, about 80 JOD per night
